correctness.rationale: Over the full algebraic closure, torus and zero-coordinate strata give exactly 20 singular lines and one isolated point; direct expansion gives f=C+Q. The cubic tangent cone is smooth by the five-coordinate Jacobian criterion, hence the blowup is smooth at its exceptional cubic with discrepancy zero. Four quadratic gradient initial forms are a regular sequence (no common projective zero); their Hilbert series is (1+t)^4 and the initial-regular-sequence lemma gives local Jacobian length 16. Characteristic-two Euler identity puts f into its gradient ideal; hence Tjurina length 16. Global normality follows via R1/S2. Embedded verify.py independently checks polynomial identities, finite incidence, and graded linear-algebra ranks; finite enumeration is not used as an infinite proof.
